evidence_boundary: R105 replaces only the four instance FFNs with four dense FF experts per layer. A learns input-independent bias-softmax mixing through zero router inputs; it is not fixed uniform after initialization. B routes from current post-attention node representations. Both start with exactly the same complete fresh tensors and uniform gates, and both compute all four experts. Each has3,425,561 total parameters; A has2,048 intentionally inactive zero-gradient router feature weights, so active functional freedom is not matched. No sparse-compute or equal-FLOPs claim. Original R88B physical TSP node0 role, methodID+34, geometry/distance, score MLP/maximin and original CE/comparison/risk/two-forward R-Drop remain. No teacher, source vectors, context labels, new targets, routing calibration, quota or auxiliary loss. R89A AdamW, R89B Muon and R84A are saved historical references, not rerun or newly parameter/FLOP-matched controls. Fixed36 rescues, losses, false picks and aligned net costs are separate from choice frequency. Native/FP64 ind and legal pools; TRAIN-fitted SBS; ALL task-equal. TEST is development-exposed; one whole-model full18 VAL checkpoint; no TEST/LIB reselection. First128 VAL/task routing is input-only post-lock descriptive evidence, not efficacy or proof against coarse shortcuts. Actual standalone GPU-resident input timing excludes dataset I/O, CPU transfer and solvers. No online W&B equality/availability is asserted.

A_static_gate.rule: strict minimum whole18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct; first exact tie; common full-TRAIN SBS
A_static_gate.inference_rule: original score MLP utility differences and maximin; no calibration or solver quotas
A_static_gate.winner_rule: native int64 ind from locked source cache, verified against original FP64 argmin; never FP32 argmin
